entry.title: Back to work: Product launch & 10% site-wide promo
entry.summary:
From September 1 - 5, take advantage of a 10% store-wide sale, as we launch two new incredible products: the iCopy-X, a powerful Proxmark-based RFID Cloner, and the iCS Decoder, an iCLASS SE and iCLASS SEOS cloner and decoder.

More
entry.content:
To welcome you back to your desk, the Lab401 team has been working hard over summer to launch new & exclusive tools.

We'll also be running a 10% store-wide promo from the 1st - 5th of September. Be sure to take advantage of this promo to get an incredible deal on the new products. Like always - everyone qualifies - there's no limits, no catches, and no coupons to enter - just grab the products you need and get 10% off.

We're proud to announce the product launch of the iCopy-X and iCS Decoder.
Both tools are exclusive to Lab401 in Europe, Australia and New Zealand.

iCopy-X

It's finally here - the iCopy-X is the powerful portable RFID cloning device that everyone's been talking about.
Built on the Proxmark 3, its easy to use interface takes the hassle out of RFID cloning. It supports the majority of HF and LF cards on the market, and is a must have for pentesters and security researchers.

Check out the iCopy-X here.

iCLASS SE / SEOS Cloner

The iCS Decoder is the world's first device that can decode and clone iCLASS SE and iCLASS SEOS badges. The device leverages an exploit that is enabled by default in SE / SEOS system to create legacy badges dervied from SE / SEOS badges.
The iCS Decoder is an accessory for the iCopy-X.

Check out the iCS Decoder here.

PandwaRF Marauder Ultimate

Purpose built for deaddrop / standalone signal capture, the PandwaRF Marauder Ultimate integrates with the PandwaRF Rogue Pro for full signal analysis, processing, brand and model detection and signal transformation.

Check out the PandwaRF Marauder Ultimate here.

Portapack for the HackRF

The PortaPack converts the HackRF One into the ultimate portable SDR multi-tool.
Dozens of built-in functions for sniffing, spoofing, recording, replaying and analyzing on the go. No cables or external computer required - the Portapack is a standalone, portable SDR solution.

Check out the PortaPack here.

With 10% off store-wide and new exclusive products - we hope that getting back to work is a little bit less difficult.

As always - if you have any questions or concerns - please reach out directly to our fantastic customer support: support@lab401.com

Lab401 Steve.

entry.title: Lab401 Q3 Sale: New Products, New Support, Huge Discounts
entry.summary:
From September 5 - 10, enjoy up to 20% at Lab401.
Our Pentester Packs and Pentester Tag Packs are on sale - and we've also added some exciting new products: Proxmark 3 RDV4, Proxmark 3 EVO and the Keysy LF Duplicator.

More
entry.content:
Summer is over: September means back to work & university.

At Lab401, it means our Annual Q3 Sale, new products and better service.

20% Sale
For one week only - Sept 5 - 10 - enjoy huge discounts on our most popular products:

  • Lab401 Pentester Pack: 10% Discount
    Including the newly released Proxmark 3 RDV4 - the pentester pack is the must-have pack for getting started with RFID.
    With the discount, you'll save over 100 EU off RRP.

  • Lab401 Pentester Tag Pack: 10% Discount
    Our impressive card range is available bundled by usage: Basic, Android and Advanced. 
    During our sale, you'll save an additional 10% across all packs!

  • Proxmark 3 RDV2: 20% Discount
    The PM3 RDV2 has never been this affordable. We are running low on stock - so be quick to jump on this discount.

  • Segger JTag Tool
    Invaluable when you need to reflash your Proxmarks - enjoy 20% off these must-have devices.

New Products
We've added three new incredible products:

  • Proxmark 3 RDV4
    The RDV4 is a Proxmark 3 revision optimised for pen-testers and red-teamers.
    Featuring exchangeable antennas, SIM/SAM slot, and expansion headers - all fitted into a palm-sized case.

  • Proxmark 3 EVO
    The Proxmark EVO / Evolution is the latest Proxmark 3 revision for desktop / university / home users. Featuring pre-tuned, built-in antennas in a compact case with RGB LED - the EVO is the economical option for users working in the lab or at home. 
  • Keysy RFID Duplicator / Emulator
    The Keysy is a must have for any RFID tester. The size and shape of a car-remote - it can sniff, emulate and duplicate a vast array of LF tags quickly and easily. Powerful yet highly economical - your toolkit needs one of these.

Customer Support
We have listened to your feedback, and are proud to launch a totally new customer support service - 6 days a week with guaranteed reply in under 24 hours.

As Lab401 has grown, it has been difficult to maintain customer support to the level that you deserve - so we are proud to unveil the new support system - and look forward to hearing your thoughts.
